title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Kanmani breaks down after rejecting Anbu's closeness and refuses to believe in him again. Devastated by her decision, Anbu gives up hope of rebuilding their relationship.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
description: After the doctor saves Ilamathi, she learns her food is poisoned. Recalling that she has sent the same batter to the ashram, she rushes there with Paraman and saves the children.

title: Suttum Vizhi Sudare
description: Karna troubles Abinaya by demanding that she vacate her house, citing changed loan terms. Vetri challenges Karna, vowing to clear her entire debt within two days.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Feeling remorseful for her mistakes, Poongodi takes charge of the household and prepares food for the family. Seeing her transformation, Pechi feels delighted.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Considering Lakshmi's health, Mathi and Malar persuade her to join them for a morning walk. Lakshmi is startled when she spots Ragavan as they walk.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Pandian insists that Senthil manage Pandian Stores' business alongside Saravanan. Meena and Gomathi comfort Thangamayil and take her home with them.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
episodeTitle: Nila and Chozhan Hide the Truth
description: Nila and Chozhan lie to Cheran, claiming Chandrayatha's family has arrived for the reception. Pallavan tries to reassure Cheran, who grows worried, sensing that something is wrong.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Eshwari rejoices after learning that Tamizhselvi's loan sanction is blocked. She is shocked to see Tamizhselvi arrive with her family for the children's ear-piercing ceremony.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Aadhavan arrives at the shop with Pooja while Karthik and Kasthuri shop for dresses. Spotting Karthik, he quickly hides himself, fearing his secret love will be exposed.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Kandhasamy publicly scolds Sarasu after her delay causes customers to leave the mess. Deeply hurt by his words, she walks out of the home, leading the family to search for her.

title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
episodeTitle: The Common Man: The Ranking Battle
description: The Ranking Task sparks heated clashes as Jayson, Shobha, Manivannan and Priyanka Paul fight for their spots, with the final rankings and an elimination awaiting them.
